cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(forge_ci_llvm_cxx_abi LANGUAGES C CXX)

find_package(LLVM 22.1.8 EXACT REQUIRED CONFIG)
if(NOT LLVM_ENABLE_RTTI OR NOT "X86" IN_LIST LLVM_TARGETS_TO_BUILD)
   message(FATAL_ERROR "HARNESS_ERROR: LLVM must provide RTTI and native X86")
endif()
if(NOT TARGET LLVM)
   message(FATAL_ERROR "HARNESS_ERROR: missing LLVM target used by Forge")
endif()

add_executable(llvm_cxx_abi main.cpp)
target_compile_features(llvm_cxx_abi PRIVATE cxx_std_23)
target_include_directories(llvm_cxx_abi SYSTEM PRIVATE ${LLVM_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(llvm_cxx_abi PRIVATE LLVM)
target_link_options(llvm_cxx_abi PRIVATE "LINKER:-Map,${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/llvm-cxx-abi.linkmap")

# Match Forge's LLVM target and WAMR wamrc's non-dylib library selection.
set(_selected LLVM)
if(NOT LLVM_LINK_LLVM_DYLIB)
   list(APPEND _selected ${LLVM_AVAILABLE_LIBS})
endif()
list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES _selected)
set(_paths "")
foreach(_target IN LISTS _selected)
   if(NOT TARGET ${_target})
      message(FATAL_ERROR "HARNESS_ERROR: missing selected LLVM target ${_target}")
   endif()
   get_target_property(_type ${_target} TYPE)
   if(_type STREQUAL "STATIC_LIBRARY" OR _type STREQUAL "SHARED_LIBRARY")
      string(APPEND _paths "$<TARGET_FILE:${_target}>\n")
   endif()
endforeach()
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/selected-libraries.txt" CONTENT "${_paths}")
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/package.txt"
   "version=${LLVM_PACKAGE_VERSION}\nrtti=${LLVM_ENABLE_RTTI}\nLLVM_DIR=${LLVM_DIR}\n")
